estimandDefinitions.episode_weighted_resolved: failures / resolved episodes in each arm; difference of arm ratios
estimandDefinitions.task_weighted_resolved: mean of all declared task failure proportions in each arm; paired mean difference

limits: A synthetic illustration is not an empirical robot or agent measurement.
Input declarations do not verify matching, rubric validity, task independence or custody.
Task resampling assumes independent exchangeable task clusters; residual task dependence remains explicit.
Exhaustive draws are exact for the empirical bootstrap distribution, not exact population confidence coverage.
Small task populations and degenerate distributions can make nominal intervals unreliable.
Unresolved outcomes are excluded only from the disclosed resolved estimands; selection can bias them.
A matched observational contrast alone does not establish a causal attack effect.
Duplicating episodes within existing tasks adds no independent task sampling units.

conditions.agent: authored toy, no framework or model execution
conditions.budget: the same declared conditions in both arms
conditions.rubric: shared declared binary task failure criterion

conditions.agent: authored toy, no framework or model execution
conditions.budget: the same declared conditions in both arms
conditions.rubric: shared declared binary task failure criterion

matching.outcomeCriteria: failure means the declared task outcome fails the same rubric; success means it meets that rubric; unresolved means no supported binary label.

population.episodes: Every authored attack and benign episode, including one unresolved label in each arm of T04.
population.independenceBasis: Independent exchangeable task clusters are a hypothetical resampling assumption, not an empirical finding.
population.residualDependence: A real shared agent, scene, session or robot can correlate tasks; this toy does not measure or rule out that dependence.
population.selection: Task sizes and labels were deliberately chosen to make unequal weighting and missing labels visible.
population.tasks: The complete four-task authored illustration T01 through T04; no sampled robot tasks.
